learned_patterns.pattern: No CLU session ran for 10 days (06-30 -> 07-10) and the signal matrix is 10 days old — both the Signal Engine and the scheduled session trigger stopped firing. The §2.5 SAFE-MODE guard correctly blocked action on stale data, but the deeper failure is that the automation went dark while the book carried live fractional-stop exposure. Fixing the GitHub Actions scheduler/runner is the top priority.

NVDA breached its $190.04 stop intraday on 06-29 ($189.80) and was NOT sold, because that session's fractional_positions.json was written to a feature branch while the monitor reads main. Stops that live only on a feature branch do not protect the book — every session's fractional file must reach main promptly. INTC's 07-07 breach WAS caught and sold, confirming the monitor works when fed on main; the NVDA miss was a data-plumbing gap, not a logic bug.

The INTC stop-out dropped LAB from 25.9% to 17.9% — under its 20% Accumulation cap — with no force-selling. The cap self-corrected via an organic exit exactly as §17.3 intends, re-opening headroom for one disciplined LAB add (NET) once a fresh matrix lifts SAFE MODE.
